title: Why Does the U.S. Military Seem Stymied in the War With Iran?
text:
Defense analyst Stacie Pettyjohn, a senior fellow and program director at the Center for a New American Security, says while the U.S. military is facing long-range missile shortages, prolonged deployments and vacated regional bases, Iran is building cheaper weapons quickly.
Listen to the full interview on NPR.
